{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast]]

It's now easy to find oat bran in the bulk section of the supermarket, but it's often hard to find the right ratios of bran, water and salt online. This is an original recipe.

== Ingredients ==

* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[cookbook:oats|oat bran]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[cookbook:water|water]]
* ⅛ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] water.
#Stir in oat bran and salt
#Reduce heat and cook for 4–6 minutes

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|Maple syrup]] and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]] are great additions to oat bran cereal.
